kpis.signal_en: Solid organic growth with 81.1K net rooms in 2025.
kpis.description_en: Net additions reflect true network growth after departures. In 2025, net growth reached 6.7%.
kpis.explanation_en: Number of rooms added to the network after deducting departures.

kpis.signal_en: Massive pipeline of 520.5K rooms, evidence of sustainable future growth.
kpis.description_en: The pipeline represents hotels under development. In 2025, it reaches 3,703 hotels for 520,500 rooms.
kpis.explanation_en: Total number of rooms in hotels scheduled to open in the future.

kpis.signal_en: 243 million members, +15% year-over-year: key driver of recurrence and loyalty.
kpis.description_en: The Hilton Honors program is central to customer retention. It counted 243M members at end of 2025.

kpis.signal_en: 1.35 million rooms across 9,158 hotels, confirmed global leadership.
kpis.description_en: At end of 2025, Hilton operates 1.35M rooms across 143 countries.
kpis.explanation_en: Total number of rooms across all hotels in the network.

kpis.signal_en: 9,158 operating hotels, solid foundation for future growth.
kpis.description_en: The global network comprises 9,158 hotels at end of 2025.
kpis.explanation_en: Total number of hotels in the global network.

kpis.signal_en: Organic growth of 6.7%, among the highest in the hospitality sector.
kpis.explanation_en: Annual growth rate of room count after departures.

kpis.signal_en: Total assets of 16.77B$ in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.

kpis.signal_en: Total debt of 13.09B$ in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.

kpis.signal_en: Dividends per share of 0.15$ in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the past 7 reported fiscal years.

kpis.signal_en: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.143B$ in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the past 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.signal_en: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 9.8% in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the past 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.

kpis.signal_en: Total revenue of 12.039B$ in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the past 8 reported fiscal years 10-K.

kpis.signal_en: Net income of 1.457B$ in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the past 8 reported fiscal years 10-K.

hero_kpi_rationale_en: Net room openings are the primary indicator of organic growth in hospitality, reflecting the strength of the asset-light model and global pipeline expansion.

ai_positioning.summary_en: Hilton acknowledges growing AI-related threats in the context of cyberattacks, but does not integrate AI as a strategic element of its operational model or product offering.
evidence_en: 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors: explicit mention of sophisticated cyberattacks leveraging AI.

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company explicitly mentions cyberattacks as a major risk, with high-intensity language and context of increasing threat sophistication, including AI-powered threats.

risks.title: Information Technology Systems Dependence
risks.score_rationale_en: The company relies heavily on its information technology and technology systems, exposing it to outages and service disruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, which may impact its business and results.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale_en: The company operates in a competitive market with established players and new entrants, which may impact its market share and results.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company operates across many countries and territories (143), making it vulnerable to geopolitical risks, such as conflicts, sanctions, and regime changes.

risks.title: Dependence on Partners and Owners
risks.score_rationale_en: The company depends on its partners and owners to deliver services, making it vulnerable to partner failures or service interruptions.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is subject to reputation risks, including non-compliance with regulations, security issues, or quality of service problems.

risks.title: The segments of the hospitality industry in which we operate are subject to intense competition

tagline: To fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality
